|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]]. Other versions: [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]] (original), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2) and [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, the current text). The slip of the re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet shown here ([[:File:VB7-01-Master_Kenobi.png]]) prints this text.
* '''Original''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]]): text of the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet as first published (official text as of 3 June 2011). No copy of that first printing has been found; the text is the 23 June 2011 errata text without “[Maintenance] cards or”, which the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” says the errata added: “While ‘communing’: you may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan’s Hut).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” (23 June 2011) added “[Maintenance] cards or”; the re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (still headed 3 June 2011, PDF dated 25 July 2011) prints the same text: “While ‘communing’: you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan’s Hut).”.<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The same Competitive Balance Team errata was posted on the Players Committee rules forum on 22 June 2011, effective immediately, a day before the news post<ref name="pcforum-p632630">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 22 June 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p632630 forum post])</ref>.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) added “may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to”, printed “once per turn,” twice (as published) and changed “Pile; Once per turn” to “Pile; once per turn” (the card list writes the ▼ icon as “\/”): “While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan's Hut).”.<ref name="cl-1273_27-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 12) removed the repeated “once per turn,”: “While ‘communing’: you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan’s Hut).”.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-masterkenobi-pre.gif]]) prints this text with “Once per turn” capitalised (a capitals-only difference, not recorded as a version; held for a ruling). The Players Committee posted this text on its rules forum on 11 April 2012 as a Competitive Balance Team errata, legal from 20 April 2012<ref name="pcforum-p710277">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 11 April 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p710277 forum post])</ref>. That is earlier than the first archived copy of the card-list wording with the repeated “once per turn,” (PC-E2, 21 July 2012).
